text: An app that helps students with their problems. Students will love it.
Pickup and composting for university canteens. Canteens pay us ₹10 per kilo collected. 12 canteens in Pune signed a pilot in March and 9 renewed in September.
Drones that deliver medicine to villages without roads. We will start with 100 drones next month across three states.
A peer-to-peer lending app for college students. Students lend each other money at 2% a month. We don't need a licence because it's between friends.
A marketplace connecting freelance tutors with parents. Tutors list their subjects and parents book sessions.
Kirana dukaan ke liye WhatsApp pe udhaar ledger. 50 dukaan roz use kar rahe hain, aur 20 ne ₹199 mahina dena shuru kiya.
A food delivery app like Swiggy but cheaper for students.
A soil sensor for smallholder farmers at $500 a month. Our farmers earn about $100 a month.
A blockchain platform to store documents forever.
API audit logs for startups preparing for SOC2. Live with 10 paying teams at $99 a month; 3 more in trial.
Late night meals delivered to the hostel gate at 11 pm. Wardens allow vendors at the gate. 40 students pre-ordered last week.
Selling cafeteria analytics only to hostel wardens, not to students, even though every food app sells to students. Two wardens are piloting it.
